change.summary: Parse each JAR manifest from the exact bounded byte buffer already read to establish its checksum and file-stability identity.
change.removed_work: One unconditional second full-file read and allocation per discovered JAR.
retained_invariants: Metadata is checked before and after the checksum read.
Length and modification time must remain stable.
The exact same bytes establish SHA-256 identity and manifest expansion.
Manifest entry count, traversal, cycle, and precedence bounds are unchanged.
The byte buffer is dropped after the artifact is registered and is not a retained cache.

fresh_process_warm_cache.assessment: Classpath discovery remained approximately 1.16 seconds, so this result does not establish a latency improvement. Active navigation happened earlier while sibling completion happened later because scheduler/resource ordering differed from the adjacent run; neither change is attributed to the removed read.
